features: Truly airtight, simply intuitive. Evak Fresh saver is a patented, fully functional innovation. No switches, Pumps or levers needed and best yet, valves never need replacing.
Fresher longer. Scientifically proven to keep your flavors locked into the container. Air is the enemy of your food, coffee or tea. . 5 qtr., . 4 L, 1. 8 cup capacity

Resists odors and stains. Our evak Fresh saver is built to the highest standards, Only BPA free plastic touches your food, coffee or tea. Evak Fresh saver is dishwasher safe for best care and longevity.
Awarded the number 1 choice ‘best storage containers to keep food fresh’ by both good housekeeping and progressive grocer.
The evak Fresh saver has now won 4 Internationally recognized awards for its cosmetic design and its practical functionality.
description: Air takes out the freshness, EVAK Fresh Saver takes out the air! The longer your food is exposed to air, the faster it loses flavor. Plastic containers with air-tight lids are readily available, but they trap stale air in with your precious food. Evacuate the air and keep food fresher, longer with EVAK Fresh Saver BPA free plastic storage containers by Prepare. Scientifically tested. Our Evak Fresh Saver container was tested against the leading brand of storage container and there was no comparison. The Evak Fresh Saver locked in flavors for longer and kept contents fresher. Still not convinced? Try one! We have a 5 year for satisfaction and quality. We are sure you’ll love it. It's so simple- just push down, then pull up; no buttons or levers. Perfect for coffee, tea, cereal, dried fruits, granola, herbs, spices, confections, etc. Twin valve system automatically forces the air out as you push down the lid, and allows you to easily pull up and remove the lid for access. Lid acts as a plunger; hear the whoosh as the air is displaced! Designed in the USA by a very prolific team, famous for many household ‘must-have’ tools and gadgets EVAK Fresh Saver was funded on Kickstarter in just 2 days. Evak Fresh Saver has since gone on to win numerous awards and accolades for its functionality and beauty. You can see Evak Fresh Savers in use at some very discerning restaurants and coffee roasters why not your counter too!
